newsitem.title: USA: CBOT July soy jumps 30-ct limit on supply concerns.
newsitem.headline: CBOT July soy jumps 30-ct limit on supply concerns.

text.p: Worries that near-term supplies of soybeans are too low pushed July up the 30-cent trading limit on Friday, traders said.
"Old crop is still pretty tight," a trader said.
Strength also came from technical buying. July pushed through several key levels that triggered buy-stop orders, floor traders said
At 1054 CDT, July was up 25 cents at $8.66-1/2 and other months were four to 13-1/4 cents higher.
